+#cloud-config
+bootcmd:
+  - |
+    set -eu
+    uplink=
+    for device in /sys/class/net/*; do
+      test -e "$device/device" || continue
+      candidate="${device##*/}"
+      case "$candidate" in eth0|enp1s0) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
+      test -z "$uplink"
+      uplink="$candidate"
+    done
+    test -n "$uplink"
+    test ! -L /etc/systemd/network
+    test -d /etc/systemd/network
+    directory="/etc/systemd/network/10-netplan-$uplink.link.d"
+    test ! -L "$directory"
+    mkdir -p "$directory"
+    link="$directory/10-nvkr-local-name.conf"
+    link_expected="$(printf "[Link]\\nNamePolicy=\\nName=%s\\n" "$uplink")"
+    test ! -L "$link"
+    if [ -e "$link" ]; then
+      test -f "$link"
+      test "$(cat "$link")" = "$link_expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$link_expected" > "$link"
+    fi
+    file=/etc/default/grub.d/zz-nvkr-local-network.cfg
+    expected='GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="${GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX} net.ifnames=1 network-config=disabled"'
+    test ! -L "$file"
+    if [ -e "$file" ]; then
+      test -f "$file"
+      test "$(cat "$file")" = "$expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$expected" > "$file"
+    fi
+    update-grub
+hostname: {{ .Hostname }}
+preserve_hostname: false
+manage_etc_hosts: true
+ssh_pwauth: true
+package_update: false
+package_upgrade: false
+
+write_files:
+{{- if .TeleportEnabled }}
+  - path: /etc/teleport.yaml

+    permissions: '0600'

+      # Managed by NVKE Cloud Workflow Engine — do not edit manually.
+      version: v3
+      teleport:
+        nodename: {{ .Hostname }}
+        data_dir: /var/lib/teleport
+        join_params:
+          token_name: {{ .TeleportTokenName }}
+          method: {{ .TeleportJoinMethod }}
+        proxy_server: {{ .TeleportProxyAddress }}
+        log:
+          output: stderr
+          severity: INFO
+          format:
+            output: json
+        diag_addr: 127.0.0.1:3000
+      ssh_service:
+        enabled: "yes"
+        labels:
+{{ indent 10 .TeleportLabels }}
+      auth_service:
+        enabled: "no"
+      proxy_service:
+        enabled: "no"
+{{- end }}
+  - path: /etc/spire-agent/agent.conf
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0644'
+    content: |
+      agent {
+          data_dir = "/var/lib/spire-agent"
+          log_level = "DEBUG"
+
+          server_address = "{{ .SpireServerAddress }}"
+          server_port = "{{ .SpireServerPort }}"
+
+          trust_domain = "{{ .TrustDomain }}"
+          trust_bundle_path = "/etc/spire-agent/initial-trust-bundle.pem"
+      }
+
+      plugins {
+          KeyManager "disk" {
+              plugin_data {
+                  directory = "/var/lib/spire-agent"
+              }
+          }
+
+          NodeAttestor "tpm" {
+              plugin_cmd = "/usr/local/lib/spire-agent/tpm_attestor_agent"
+              plugin_checksum = "${TPM_PLUGIN_CHECKSUM}"
+              plugin_data {}
+          }
+
+          WorkloadAttestor "unix" {
+              plugin_data {}
+          }
+      }
+  - path: /etc/spire-agent/initial-trust-bundle.pem
+    owner: root:root

+		name    string
+		args    []string
+		handled bool
+		code    int

+	var diagnostic bytes.Buffer

+	if !handled || code != 1 || diagnostic.Len() == 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("handled=%v code=%d", handled, code)
+	}

global:
  skipCallToK8s: true

    image: &built_image

      sha256: ""
ovnkube-single-node-zone:
  ovnkubeSingleNodeZone:
    image: *built_image
  ovnkubeSingleNodeZoneNbdb:
    image: *built_image
  ovnkubeSingleNodeZoneSbdb:
    image: *built_image
  ovnkubeSingleNodeZoneNorthd:
    image: *built_image
  ovnkubeSingleNodeZoneOvnHost:
    image: *built_image
EOF
for kind in charts images; do
  root="$out/$kind"
  cat >"$root/DEBIAN/control" <<EOF
Package: nke-cni-ovn-$kind-$stream

Architecture: {{.Arch}}

Provides: nke-cni-ovn-$kind
Conflicts: nke-cni-ovn-$kind
Description: NVKE OVN $kind from pinned DSX source
EOF
done
printf 'Depends: containerd | nke-kubeadm-distro\n' >>"$images/DEBIAN/control"
gzip -n -9 -c /nvkr/inputs/materials/ovn-image >"$image_dir/$image_name"
(cd "$image_dir" && sha256sum "$image_name" >"$image_name.sha256")
# Preserve the offline containerd import contract and fail configuration
# on checksum, readiness or import errors.
cat >"$images/DEBIAN/postinst" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
set -euo pipefail
[ "${1:-}" = configure ] || exit 0
readonly image_dir=/usr/lib/nke/cni-ovn/2.4.2
readonly image_name=ovn-images_2.4.2_linux_{{.Arch}}.tgz
if [ -n "${NKE_CTR_BIN:-}" ]; then
  ctr="$(command -v "$NKE_CTR_BIN")" || { echo "OVN import: ctr is not executable: $NKE_CTR_BIN" >&2; exit 1; }
elif [ -x /usr/local/bin/ctr ]; then
  ctr=/usr/local/bin/ctr
else
  ctr="$(command -v ctr)" || { echo 'OVN import: ctr not found' >&2; exit 1; }
fi
[ -f "$ctr" ] && [ -x "$ctr" ] || { echo "OVN import: ctr is not executable: $ctr" >&2; exit 1; }
readonly ctr
readonly log=/var/log/nke-cni-ovn-postinst.log
cd "$image_dir"
sha256sum --strict -c "$image_name.sha256"
ready=false
for ((n=0; n<50; n++)); do
  if timeout --kill-after=1s 2s "$ctr" version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ready=true; break
  fi
  sleep 0.2
done
"$ready" || { echo 'OVN import: containerd readiness timed out' >&2; exit 1; }
gzip -dc "$image_name" | timeout --kill-after=5s 300s "$ctr" -n k8s.io images import - >>"$log" 2>&1 \
  || { echo "OVN import failed; see $log" >&2; exit 1; }
EOF

for kind in charts images; do
  root="$out/$kind"
  find "$root" -print0 | xargs -0 touch -h -d "@$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH"
  dpkg-deb --root-owner-group --uniform-compression -Zxz -z6 --build "$root" \
    "$out/debs/nke-cni-ovn-${kind}-${stream}_${revision}_{{.Arch}}.deb"
done
tar --format=ustar --sort=name --mtime="@$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" --owner=0 --group=0 \
